worldcombat.skill.imprison.summary: Raises a moving seal and picks one direct-offense class — contact or non-contact: inside it each foe you can see has only its first attack of that class turned back and its lock-mark shattered, then attacks normally; for the duration you also may not use that class yourself.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.use.0: Turn back the first blow of each melee attacker around you
worldcombat.skill.imprison.use.1: Deny the opening shot of a ranged exchange
worldcombat.skill.imprison.use.2: Trade a self-class cost for one interception per foe
worldcombat.skill.imprison.description.0: The seal stays on the caster for %1$s: the domain moves with you and each foe you can see inside it carries one lock-mark.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.description.1: The field radius is %1$s blocks. It is also the real check radius: a foe's first matching hit is turned back only while it is still inside and its line to you is not cut by cover.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.category.cont: This seal locks contact: each foe inside has its first melee direct attack turned back once, then attacks normally; for the duration you also may not use melee direct attacks. Status, damage over time and environmental damage are unaffected.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.category.rang: This seal locks non-contact: each foe inside has its first ranged direct attack turned back once, then attacks normally; for the duration you also may not use ranged direct attacks. Status, damage over time and environmental damage are unaffected.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.description.2: Raising the seal takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. One source keeps only one domain; recasting before it ends does not refresh a foe's spent share.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.scope.0: Deep: domain x0.8, duration x1.35, cooldown x1.15 — hold one patch longer.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.scope.1: Wide: domain x1.25, duration x0.75, cooldown x0.9 — cover more ground for less time.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.timing: Cast on yourself: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s, the cooldown %5$s from commit, and the current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.preference.sc: Deep: domain x0.8, duration x1.35, cooldown x1.15. Wide: domain x1.25, duration x0.75, cooldown x0.9. Trade the size of the domain for how long it holds.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.preference.ca: Contact turns back each inside foe's first melee direct attack but also bars your own melee direct attacks. Non-contact does the same for the first ranged direct attack and your own ranged attacks. Each class has its own gap; status, damage over time and environmental damage are unaffected.
worldcombat.skill.imprison.preference.ai: The partner only considers the seal while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger raises it for foes further out.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the seal.
world_combat.move.imprison.text.self: Seal: you cannot use your own %1$s either
